all.reason: Hybrid GC (#5940): low-survival allocation churn now runs stop-the-world generational minors, so objectAllocation's collector cost follows survivors instead of allocation. The young generation is sized by collector duty (up to host memory / 8), which trades some RAM on this row for 3x fewer minors (linux-arm64's RAM ratio rose 0.24x -> 0.38x, still well under JDK 25).
